# volcano_durable_function_deployments (Data Source)

Deployment history for a durable function.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "volcano_durable_function_deployments" "workflow" {
  project_id  = volcano_project.example.id
  function_id = volcano_durable_function.workflow.id
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `function_id` (String)
- `project_id` (String)

### Read-Only

- `deployments` (Attributes List) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--deployments))
